team_registration: Automatic first-use team name and shared-password sign-in. The supplied client stores a separate device credential outside Git and reuses it for results and diagnostics.
team_identity_scope: Self-registered team access. Possession of the agreed shared password is not verification of GitHub membership or university identity.
preview_scope: Optional own-plan CPU geometry and actual recorded Genesis robot/cup/bead playback. Read-only export does not rerun physics or create a validation certificate.
scope: Three-bead student workspace approved for release on the validated current PC. Supplied first-use sign-in, real result upload/retry/history and owned-test cleanup passed. GTX1660 SUPER performance is unmeasured. No reference solution is included.
release_authorization_scope: Instructor authorized the three-bead revision and publication. Current-PC student release is approved after source-bound validation, final document/media review, exact official rule activation and the supplied HTTPS account/result flow. Public Git publication and LMS delivery are separate operational actions.
safe_supplied_file_updates: check/apply/status/rollback with official release hashes, backups and preservation of student work
student_repository_visibility: one private shared repository per team
contribution_evidence: Each member uses their own account to commit and push. Present their actual contribution using the shared repository history.
public_leaderboard_privacy: Results only. Other teams cannot access design inputs, joint paths, full receipts or diagnostics.

optional_visual_export.inside_view: Transparent cup, follow camera and cup-only interior view

Cropped PNGs and encoded media use the supplied recorded-state renderer. They are not live Genesis viewport screenshots. Actual browser video encoding and download remain unverified.

inactive_parking_native_initial_state_ch.scope: Current compact parking was checked by source-bound initial fingerprints and complete collision/control/handling checks throughout four Lower/Moderate full reviews. No old 50-step count is claimed as a new-source test.

compact_design_inputs.scope: Current compact design inputs passed six CPU geometry validations and seven full native reviews across all tiers. Exact archived joint paths and times were reused. Lower/Moderate evidence includes the supplied inactive parking configuration.

student_naming.solo: Own student ID for the private repository and leaderboard name
student_naming.group: All member IDs sorted ascending and joined with hyphens for one shared private repository and leaderboard name

per_arm_practice.scope: Selected saved approach, automatic pick, carry, automatic release and rest from a fresh nominal support boundary.
per_arm_practice.validation_timing_scope: Separate working copies ran sequentially on one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 PC, using shared, reused Genesis and Quadrants caches. Times cover the whole command and are elapsed wall times. They are not cold-cache, isolated GPU, GTX1660 SUPER or human-workload measurements.

official_student_account_flow.scope: Instructor-owned verification only. This is not an additional student solve or physical qualification.

student_release_approval_scope: Current-PC student release: source-bound three-bead validation, final supplied documents and recorded-state media, and the actual HTTPS student account/result flow are verified.
